what: Correctness fixes that change numerical results
title: multiRF 0.2.3
text: IMD tree-network edge ratios: build_tree_network_cpp assigned wrong parent nodesize backtracking, corrupting edge ratio second-child edges whose sibling subtree internal (22–24% edges, median ~7x small). old-vs-new comparison bit-identical fits showed reachable IMD weight path consumed corrupted values (native engine’s pre-computed IMD never uses network; weighted = FALSE never reads edge; weighted = TRUE, calc = "Y" reads never-corrupted first-child edges; calc = "X"/"" crashed outright pre-fix), IMD weights earlier versions need re-running. fix corrects edge column returned network data frames , together aggregation fix , makes weighted = TRUE usable first time. Spectral clustering: spectral_cl() now runs PAM row-normalized NJW embedding computes (returns), algorithm requires; previously clustered unnormalized eigenvectors. OOB forest weights (sub-MRF path): compute_oob_fw() longer lets sample donate OOB weight row; diagonal zero rows renormalized, matching canonical C++ implementation. cluster_metric_matrix() computes asymmetric purity metric directions instead mirroring one triangle. Robust normalized importance used L1 norm Y L2 X due transposed expression; now use L2. unsupervised C++ forest now uses portable random draws (hand-rolled integer/real draws Fisher–Yates shuffle std::mt19937), making seeded results reproducible across platforms. Draw sequences differ 0.2.2, seeded unsupervised results change .

title: multiRF 0.2.3
text: mrf3_stability() default arguments longer stops fits without robust clustering (unavailable branches skipped warning), robust branch longer treats robust_clusters list label vector (stability metrics silently NA/garbage). get_multi_weights(weighted = TRUE) longer errors (edge column dropped aggregation). mrf3_init(sub_mrf = TRUE, select_connection = TRUE, compute_oob = TRUE) works: compute_oob_forest_wt() consumes model’s forest.wt.oob directly present. Single-column response blocks longer crash importance extraction (missing drop = FALSE). Legacy character-vector connection models longer crash get_reconstr_matrix(). pairwise_imd(): duplicated feature names across omics blocks now raise informative error instead silently misattributing IMD mass; single-block 1×1 edge cases handled. Fixed dangling-reference read nodes.push_back() C++ tree builders (undefined behavior), added missing size_t casts unsupervised n×n buffer indexing (overflow n ≥ 46342).

title: multiRF 0.2.3
text: Native engine speedups, verified bit-identical across supervised, unsupervised, proximity, weighted-sampling configurations: split scan’s response buffer now sample-major (contiguous inner loop, 1.4-1.9x), per-node sorted-index partitioning uses per-tree arena instead fresh allocations (1.15x, wide blocks), per-node scratch buffers hoisted split search. macOS, R’s CRAN distribution bundles libomp enable OpenMP package compilation; installing user Makevars sets SHLIB_OPENMP_CXXFLAGS/SHLIB_OPENMP_LDFLAGS (see openmp.Makevars project root) turns native engine’s multithreaded tree building. Thread count affect results (verified identical 1/8/threads); control fit_forest(nthread = ...) options(multiRF.nthread = ...). One parallel layer time: forests fitted inside forked workers (parallel_connections, fit_sub_mrf(parallel = TRUE)) now default single-threaded OpenMP unless multiRF.nthread set explicitly. prevents core oversubscription fork--OpenMP hazard Linux/libgomp; results unchanged (verified identical).

title: multiRF 0.2.3
text: Named truth vectors passed mrf3_stability() actually aligned sample name (names stripped check). set.seed() calls fit_sub_mrf(), tuning, mrf3_stability() longer clobber caller’s global RNG state.
